name: index_repo
title: Index a repository
description: Start or resume indexing a registered repository in the background, and return the run's state at once. Incremental by default: only changed files are re-extracted, and SCIP re-runs for projects with changes, which also resolves files that automatic refreshes left pending. Set wait_seconds to block for up to that long; progress notifications are sent when the request carries a progress token. get_index_info reports progress. Registering a new repository is a CLI command, not a tool.

repo.description: Registered repository name. Optional: defaults to the repository that contains the server's working directory, or the only registered one.

mode.description: full rebuilds the index from scratch, as after a schema_version change.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the run to finish before returning its state.
